tools.name: company_research
tools.description: Search web for verified company information, tech stack, and engineering culture using Tavily API and grounded synthesis.

tools.name: evidence_validator
tools.description: Validate factual resume claims against verified web source citations using deterministic Claim Ledger verification. Rejects unsupported claims.

tools.name: jd_analyzer
tools.description: Parse target Job Description and match required skills against candidate experience with evidence classification and gap detection.

tools.name: ats_readiness
tools.description: Perform heuristic ATS compliance checks (keyword coverage, word count, metrics density, parseable formatting, contact info).

tools.name: source_filter
tools.description: Audit and categorize research source domains into authoritative tiers (Tier 1: Official/SEC, Tier 2: Reputable tech press, Tier 3: Aggregators) and discard promotional spam.

tools.name: cover_letter_generator
tools.description: Synthesize structured, evidence-grounded cover letter paragraphs with in-line citations and tone alignment.

tools.name: github_proofer
tools.description: Inspect public GitHub repositories, code languages, commit activity, stars, and forks to fact-check candidate technical claims. Validates evidence-backed claims and flags uncorroborated technical claims.

tools.name: huggingface_proofer
tools.description: Inspect public Hugging Face assets (models, spaces, datasets, lifetime and rolling 30-day downloads) to verify GenAI, LoRA, GGUF, and LLM fine-tuning claims.
